title: hkw-2001-texas-outlaw-championship
label: Jake Morgan

won.source: the promotion's own No Disqualification handicap ladder match (27 May 2001)

how: Survived a handicap No Disqualification ladder match against both State Club Boyz (Curtis and Tony), with owner David Knox as special guest referee, to climb the ladder and pull down the vacant title.
note: The title's first attested reign; still held when the promotion's own record ends (21 July 2001). Its own record separately shows Morgan taking a second belt, the rival promotion The X's own Junior Heavyweight Championship, off its champion Buddy Lee Jr. that July -- a distinct title, not folded into this one here.
